parameters.description: NBA season year for standings.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

eliminatedFromPlayoffContention.description: Whether the team has been eliminated from playoff contention.

lastTenLosses.description: Losses over the last ten games.

lastTenWins.description: Wins over the last ten games.

wonPlayInTournament.description: Whether the team advanced through the play-in tournament.
